highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update with upstream correctness fixes.
highlights_body: Linux applications relying on fontconfig fallback should review the changed fallback-face selection behavior before upgrading.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now prefers Fontconfig's FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path. Applications requiring deterministic text metrics or glyph selection should specify an explicit family and style or bundle their typeface.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 153 and incorporates upstream bug, correctness, and buffer-upload fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opened the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and upstream renderer fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 prepared the m153 line for final validation.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves the Windows native HarfBuzz build by scoping compiler warning suppression to the bundled library.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m153 engine update.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: It incorporates the current upstream renderer fixes for the 4.153 line.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Release Candidate 1 prepares the m153 update for stable release.
